answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake locked for a full epoch, like basalt bedrock under a harbor: cheap for one honest agent, ruinous to duplicate a thousand times. New identities enter only through a narrow inlet, one verified registration per epoch, so a Sybil farm cannot flood in at once. Honest work is then attested on a public ledger, crystal-clear and auditable, and any identity caught copying or gaming loses its stake and its history. The cost scales with the attack, not with honest participation.
